title: Cooperative Multi-Agent Vision-Language-Action Models via Reinforced Fine Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2609.36588v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study reinforcement learning (RL) methods for cooperative multi-agent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. This problem is challenging because VLAs are pretrained on large-scale single-agent data and therefore lack the fine-grained coordination skills required for inter-robot collaboration. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on multi-robot demonstrations partially bridges this gap, but its performance is bounded by the demonstration data and cannot improve from its own experience. We present a three-stage reinforced fine-tuning (RFT) pipeline for multi-agent VLAs. First, initialization-aware data collection sweeps over initial configurations and invokes human demonstrations only when the pretrained VLA repeatedly fails, yielding robustness to initialization shift with reduced human cost. translated_title: 通过强化微调实现协作式多智能体视觉-语言-动作模型
translated_abstract: 我们研究了面向协作式多智能体视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的强化学习（RL）方法。这个问题极具挑战性，因为VLA模型是在大规模单智能体数据上预训练的，因此缺乏机器人间协作所需的细粒度协调技能。在多机器人演示数据上进行监督微调（SFT）可以部分弥合这一差距，但其性能受限于演示数据，无法从自身经验中改进提升。我们提出了一种面向多智能体VLA的三阶段强化微调（RFT）流程。第一阶段，初始化感知的数据收集会遍历多种初始配置，仅当预训练的VLA模型反复失败时才调用人类演示，从而在降低人类成本的同时获得对初始化偏移的鲁棒性。第二阶段，离线信用过滤微调为各个智能体分配信用，并在具有正优势的单智能体轨迹上进行微调，而非……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种三阶段强化微调（RFT）流程，通过初始化感知的数据收集与离线信用过滤微调等阶段，使基于单智能体数据预训练的VLA模型获得多机器人协作能力，并能超越演示数据的限制从自身经验中持续改进。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a three-stage reinforced fine-tuning (RFT) pipeline that enables VLA models pretrained on single-agent data to acquire multi-robot coordination skills through initialization-aware data collection and offline credit-filtered tuning, allowing improvement beyond demonstration data from its own experience.
